parsed.text: This packet contains fallible location distributions for red and blue at nodes n0–n3 in two panels (p0,p1). Current distributions: in both panels n0 blue concentrates on the top-right 2×2 cells and red on the top-left 2×2 cells; nodes n1–n3 are uniform over all 16 cells. Conditional candidate records vary by command key: k0 in both panels matches the bimodal pattern at n0 and uniform elsewhere; k1 is uniform everywhere; k2 concentrates at n0 with blue peaked at cell [0,2] and red peaked at cell [0,0], and is uniform at other nodes. Copied prior records in origins are not new estimates; native conditional records are conditional scenarios, not executed events.
